landing.metaTitle: A House Divided | Political & Economic Sim Game
landing.metaDescription: Real-time multiplayer political and economic simulation: run for office, pass legislation, build parties, run corporations, and trade markets in the US, UK, Germany, and Japan. The world advances every hour; progression never resets.
landing.scrollCue: Drag the globe · scroll to enter
landing.carouselDek: The people in charge, and the crises running live right now. Swipe or use arrow keys to browse.
landing.learnDek: Guides, a living wiki, and the in-character news wire: everything you need before your first campaign, no account required.
landing.attribution: Landing imagery via Wikimedia Commons. CC BY 4.0: "1977 Israeli legislative election" by Danny Gotfried / Israel Press and Photo Agency (Dan Hadani collection, National Library of Israel). CC BY-SA 2.0: "Berlin, Checkpoint Charlie" by Roger Wollstadt. All other landing images are public domain (NARA / EPA DOCUMERICA / White House / Library of Congress / Federal Reserve / FSA-OWI). Leader portraits via Wikimedia Commons, public domain: George H.W. Bush by David Valdez / White House; John Major by PFC Tracey L. Hall-Leahy, U.S. Army; Deng Xiaoping, public domain.

tiles.stateMetricsBody: Track demographics, unemployment, and the institutional trust every incumbent is spending down.
tiles.ballotBody: Run for House, Senate, Governor, or the state legislature. Primaries first, then the general.
tiles.billsBody: Draft bills, whip votes, and trade amendments to get your programme through the chamber.
tiles.industrialBody: Found corporations, grow sectors, and pay dividends out of what you build.
tiles.marketsBody: Trade commodities and currencies against every other economy in the world.
tiles.newsroomBody: Follow every bill, crisis, and cabinet shuffle through the in-game wire and wiki.
tiles.centralBanksBody: Set the prime rate and manage a line of credit for a whole national economy.

learnLinks.guidesBody: Step-by-step guides to running for office, founding corporations, and trading bonds, forex, and commodities.
learnLinks.wikiBody: The full reference: elections, legislation, parties, central banks, and every country in the simulation.
learnLinks.newsBody: Player-written headlines, campaign coverage, and policy editorials straight from the live world.
learnLinks.faqBody: How the hourly game clock works, what it costs (nothing), and who builds A House Divided.
